changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE warehouses ( id BINARY(16) PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, address TEXT NOT NULL, city VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, state VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, created_date DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_by VARCHAR(255), last_modified_date DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_by VARCHAR(255) );
